question: ​Dr Jitendra Singh (Union Minister of State (Independent Charge) Science and Technology) launched the Amrit Grand Challenge Programme titled ________ in September 2021, to identify 75 innovations in Telemedicine, AI, Digital Health and BIG Data by Start-ups and Entrepreneurs.
solution:
The correct answer is __**JANCARE.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__****JANCARE**

__
 
• The **"AmritGrand Challenge Program"** titled "**JANCARE**" was introduced by** the Union Minister of State** (Independent Charge) for Science and Technology, **Dr. Jitendra Singh**,
 
• The objective of the program is to identify **75 Start-Up Innovations** in Telemedicine, Digital Health, and mHealth with BIG Data, AI, Block Chain, and others.
 
• Grand Challenge was launched at the same time as the Prime Minister's **Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav, **making it even more important for **young startups and businesspeople **to develop original ideas and solutions to **India's healthcare problems.**
 
• The 75 Best Selected Startups will help India lead the nation over the next 25 years as the nation celebrates its **100th anniversary of independence.**
 
• Speaking at the **BIRAC's 10th Biotech Innovators Meet **in New Delhi under the subject **"Vigyan se Vikash,"** Dr. Jitendra Singh promised to help startups wholeheartedly throughout the entire process, from conception to deployment. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• Jitendra Singh, an Indian politician, serves as the** Minister of State** (Independent Charge) for the Ministries of Science and Technology, Atomic Energy, and Space.
 
• He also serves as the Minister of State (Independent Charge) for the Ministry of **Earth Science, the Prime Minister's Office, and Personnel, Public Grievances, and Pensions.**
 
• He is a member of the** Bharatiya Janata Party's (BJP) **national executive and served as the primary spokesperson for the union territory of Jammu and Kashmir.
